bounds: One selected archived note, one competing note ID, up to one intervening restore and rearchive, and one permanent deletion operation.
fairness: No automatic recovery is assumed. Completion after an interruption requires the original owner and host to read the pending claim and the recording receipt, then complete the remaining writes.
limitations: The owner route and UI are outside this draft. Separate storage tests exercise the modeled transitions, but do not provide end-to-end conformance for the owner transport.
Backup copies and recordings held by another host are outside this model.
